subject: Timeboxed pilot: bridging extension & counteroffer
messages:
From: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@tidalhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tidal Health Procurement <procurement@tidalhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request + budget note

Karthik —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us — the team got strong signal on intent but hit a content coverage gap when we scaled scenarios last week. We need another 3 weeks to finish validation across our specialist workflows.

Quick asks from procurement and product:
- Can Redwood extend the existing timeboxed pilot by 3 weeks (same environment + data scope)?
- Because this is an unplanned extension, can you provide a bridging discount for the additional period (targeting ~25% off rate card for the extension)?
- We’ll need an updated usage/export report for the original pilot window to attach to the PO (CSV or similar).

If you can share a simple amendment and the usage CSV by end of week, procurement can review and issue a PO. Happy to schedule a 20-min sync if helpful.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Head of AI Programs, Tidal Health

---
Attachment: pilot-usage-request.txt (1 line request)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + budget note

Alyssa — thanks for the clear ask and the context. Glad the pilot is showing promise. I’ve reviewed with Pricing and Ops; below is a pragmatic bridging proposal that aims to keep procurement moving without impacting our ability to support the extended run.

Summary proposal (short):
- Extension: +21 days from current pilot end date (same infra and dataset scope).
- Financial: 20% discount off hosted eval rate for the extension period (we can stretch to 22% if we get a signed amendment by EOD Jun 1).
- Credits vs invoice: We can either apply the discount as a credit against the first post-pilot invoice or bill the extension at the discounted rate (your preference).
- Deliverables: we’ll attach the usage CSV for the original pilot (CSV: tidal-pilot-usage.csv) and a one-page amendment (PDF) that Procurement can sign.

Ops note (cc’d Priyom): we’ll reserve the burst capacity for the three-week window. Priyom, please confirm there are no region-specific blockers for the requested window.

If this sounds OK, I’ll draft the amendment and share the usage CSV. If procurement needs a steeper discount, let me know the internal approval threshold and I’ll escalate.

Best —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Quick ops confirmation:
- We can provision the same pool and keep the KV cache retention as-is for the +21d window. No infra changes needed.
- If Tidal scales beyond the current concurrency profile, we’ll need ~48 hours notice to add burst nodes; otherwise performance will be on the same SLOs as the original pilot.
- I attached a small CSV (tidal-pilot-usage.csv) with daily token/req counts for the original window. Kimberly — pricing side will want that in the amendment appendix.

Priyom

Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + budget note

Alyssa — glad we could work through this. Confirming the final commercial details so Procurement has everything for the PO: 
- Extension length: 21 days; start = current pilot end date + 1 day.
- Rate: 20% discount off our published eval rate for the extension period. If Albany (your legal/procurement team) signs the amendment by EOD Jun 1 we’ll apply a one-time 2% uplift to the discount (total 22%).
- Billing: discount applied as a credit on the first post-pilot invoice (we’ll display the line item as "Extension Credit (21d)").
- Attachments: tidal-pilot-usage.csv (provided by Ops), redwood-bridge-offer.pdf (amendment draft).

Next steps for Tidal:
1) Reply-all with confirmation that Procurement can accept the extension terms (length + discounted rate).
2) If yes, Procurement sends the PO to finance@redwood.ai; we’ll return a signed amendment (DocuSign link) within 24 hours.

Alyssa — appreciate the cadence. If you want the additional 2% we need the signature by EOD today; otherwise 20% goes through automatically on the amendment.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Commercial Pricing — Redwood Inference
